bead.title: opencode: emit tool_call/tool_result events from tool_use stream events
bead.description:
PROBLEM: opencode emits {"type":"tool_use","part":{"type":"tool","tool":"write","callID":"call_...","state":{"status":"completed","input":{...},"output":"Wrote file successfully."}}} (verified, opencode 1.3.17). The wrapper emits ZERO EventTypeToolCall/EventTypeToolResult (grep of internal/harnesses/opencode/ returns none), so progress observers and the ddx execution UI see no tool activity — a CONTRACT-004 ProgressEvents gap that codex and claude-tui both satisfy.

ROOT CAUSE: no tool handling in internal/harnesses/opencode/stream.go (depends on the line-scanning rewrite in the parser-rewrite bead).

PROPOSED FIX: In the rewritten parseOpencodeStream, add a type=="tool_use"/part.type=="tool" case. Decode part.state ({status,input,output,metadata}). Emit EventTypeToolCall{ID:part.callID, Name:part.tool, Input:state.input} and, since opencode emits one terminal tool_use per call with state.status=="completed" (verified), ALSO emit EventTypeToolResult{ID:part.callID, Output:state.output, Error:<set when status=="error">} from the same event so observers see the call/result pair. MIRROR codex tool framing: codex/stream.go:161-177 (call) and codex/stream.go:133-153 (result), keyed by callID.

NON-SCOPE: usage wiring; arg construction.
bead.acceptance:
1. Add fixture internal/harnesses/opencode/testdata/jsonl/tool_use.jsonl (verified write-tool run: step_start; tool_use(write->hello.txt); text; step_finish).
2. New Test TestParseOpencodeStream_ToolUseEmitsCallAndResult: an EventTypeToolCall with Name=="write" and ID=="call_..." is followed by an EventTypeToolResult with the same ID and Output containing "Wrote file successfully".
3. The tool input JSON (filePath, content) is preserved on the tool_call event's Input.
4. cd /Users/erik/Projects/fizeau && GOPRIVATE=github.com/easel/* GOSUMDB=off GOFLAGS=-mod=mod go test ./internal/harnesses/opencode/... -count=1 -timeout 120s green. Do NOT run `go test ./...` (HANGS).
5. lefthook run pre-commit passes.
